title: Multiples and Factors of Numbers to 100
seo_title: Grade 4 Multiples and Factors Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Multiples of 1-digit numbers to at least 100.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 4 multiples and factors worksheets: multiples of 1-digit numbers to 100, factors, factor pairs and word problems. 100 questions with memos.
key_big: Factors divide exactly; multiples come from multiplying.
key_sub: List factor pairs until they meet.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A multiple of a number is in its times table: the multiples of 6 are 6, 12, 18, 24, …
  • A factor divides a number exactly: 4 is a factor of 24, because 24 ÷ 4 = 6.
  • Find all the factors in pairs: 1 × 24, 2 × 12, 3 × 8, 4 × 6.
  • 1 and the number itself are always factors.

Examples

Example

Factors of 36

1 × 36, 2 × 18, 3 × 12, 4 × 9, 6 × 6

Answer: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 9, 12, 18, 36

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Factors or multiples?Factors divide; multiples come from multiplying.
Forgetting 1 and the numberThey are always factors.
Missing the middle pair6 × 6 = 36: 6 is a factor.
